title: Take-Home Pay Calculator: Federal Tax, FICA and Net Paycheck
description: Free take-home pay calculator for 2026: enter your yearly salary to estimate federal income tax, Social Security, Medicare and your net pay per paycheck.
lead: How much of your salary will actually land in your bank account? Enter your gross pay, filing status and pre-tax deductions to see an estimate of your 2026 federal taxes, FICA and your take-home pay per paycheck.
